definitions.explanation: Three times some quantity, value, or size. Formed with the counter {倍|ばい} (times).

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{三倍|さんばい}になった。
{彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{三倍|さんばい}も{食|た}べる。
examples.english: He eats three times as much as I do.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}の{家賃|やちん}は、{郊外|こうがい}の{三倍|さんばい}{以上|いじょう}することもある。
examples.english: Rent in the city center can be more than triple that of the suburbs.

notes:
Compound of {三|さん} (three) + {倍|ばい} (times). Note the rendaku: ばい → ばい (actually no rendaku here; ばい remains). Other quantities: {二倍|にばい} (double), {四倍|よんばい} (quadruple), {十倍|じゅうばい} (tenfold).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Aの{三倍|さんばい}: three times A — used with の to mark the reference point
- {三倍|さんばい}になる: to become triple, to triple (intransitive)
- {三倍|さんばい}にする: to triple something (transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三倍|さんばい}の{値段|ねだん}: triple the price
- {三倍|さんばい}に{増|ふ}える: to increase threefold
- {三倍|さんばい}{以上|いじょう}: more than three times
